projects.title: NodeCast Docs
projects.blurb: A full documentation rebuild for a blockchain data-indexing API whose existing docs were costing the team support hours every week.
projects.tools: Markdown / Docusaurus · Postman · API testing · Notion
projects.problem: Developers were abandoning integration halfway through — docs described endpoints but not the reasoning behind them.
projects.approach: Rebuilt the docs around real integration journeys instead of a flat endpoint list, with runnable examples for each step.
projects.whatIDid: Audited every endpoint, rewrote the reference docs, and added a quickstart tested against the live API.
projects.result: Fewer repeated support questions and a shorter path from signup to first successful API call.

projects.title: Auralis Onboarding
projects.blurb: An AI-assisted rebuild of a SaaS product's onboarding flow, combining prototyping, copy, and interaction design in one pass.
projects.problem: New users dropped off in a five-step onboarding wizard with unclear copy and no sense of progress.
projects.approach: Prototyped three flow variants quickly using an AI-assisted build process, then tested them against real task completion.
projects.whatIDid: Rewrote onboarding copy, restructured the flow to three steps, and built the working prototype myself.
projects.result: A shorter, clearer flow the team shipped directly with minor engineering polish.

projects.title: Glassframe Design System
projects.blurb: A component library and its documentation, built together so the design system and the docs never drift apart.
projects.problem: Design and docs were maintained separately, so the documented components regularly didn't match what shipped.
projects.approach: Treated the component docs as part of the design deliverable, not an afterthought written later.
projects.whatIDid: Designed the core components and wrote usage guidelines for each one as it was finalized.
projects.result: One source of truth for design and engineering, reducing inconsistency between the two.

projects.title: MindPath
projects.blurb: A Gemini-powered Telegram bot built with a humanized personality, vision support, and per-chat memory so conversations carry context over time.
projects.tools: Google Gemini API · Telegram Bot API · Render (hosting) · cron-job.org (uptime)
